local f=workspace:FindFirstChild('PortScene') local S={} local names={} if f then for _,m in f:GetDescendants() do if m:IsA('Model') then local n=m.Name local ok,p=pcall(function() return m:GetPivot().Position end) if ok then S[m]=p names[n]=(names[n] or 0)+1 end end end end _G.Snap=S _G.Look={} for m in S do _G.Look[m]=m:GetPivot().LookVector.Y end local o={} for n,c in names do if n=='dog-pug' or n=='cat' or n=='cow' or n=='sheep' or n=='pig' or n=='horse' or n=='chicken' or n=='donkey' or n=='Villager' then table.insert(o,n..'x'..c) end end return 'models: '..table.concat(o,', ')

local S=_G.Snap or {} local mv={} local tot={} for m,p in S do if m.Parent then local n=m.Name local ok,q=pcall(function() return m:GetPivot().Position end) if ok then local k=(n=='dog-pug' and 'dog') or n local isA=(k=='dog' or k=='cat' or k=='cow' or k=='sheep' or k=='pig' or k=='horse' or k=='chicken' or k=='donkey' or k=='Villager') if isA then tot[k]=(tot[k] or 0)+1 if ((q-p).Magnitude>0.15 or math.abs(m:GetPivot().LookVector:Dot(Vector3.new(0,1,0))-(_G.Look and _G.Look[m] or 0))>0.02) then mv[k]=(mv[k] or 0)+1 end end end end end local o={} for k,c in tot do table.insert(o,k..' moved '..(mv[k] or 0)..'/'..c) end return table.concat(o,' | ')
